images.title: File:Misty morning landscape with trees and mountain near Eiras, O Rosal, O Baixo Miño, Galicia, Spain, March 2020 - Flickr - sergei.gussev.jpg
images.author: Sergei Gussev
images.modifications: Resized by Wikimedia thumbnail service; converted to JPEG for local tests
images.description: Misty morning landscape near Eiras, O Rosal, O Baixo Miño, Galicia, Spain, March 2020. Prominent tall trees stand in a grassy field, partially obscured by fog. The backdrop features a hazy mountain under a pale blue sky, contributing to the tranquil atmosphere. The arrangement includes a mix of deciduous and evergreen trees. The scene captures the serene and ethereal quality typical of early spring mornings in Galicia.
